A1.justification: Both complete 57-page PDFs describe MMTEB and contain matching main sections and Appendices A–H. Text comparison and visual inspection support reliable comparison of the tables, figures, equations, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations in Table 2, benchmark optimization experiments in Appendix C, and English and code benchmark results in Tables 18–19.

after.justification: v2 retains the original model evaluations, optimization experiments, and English and code benchmark results in Table 2, Appendix C, and Tables 18–19.

M1.justification: The task-selection procedure, clustering bootstrapping, retrieval pooling, and embedding caching are unchanged in Sections 2.3–2.4 and Appendices B–C. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: The same tasks, languages, domains, and multilingual, European, Indic, English, and code benchmarks remain. The task inventories in Appendices B, D, and H, including Tables 12–17, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 18–19 and the appendix analyses. Section 2.2 corrects 'ultilingual-e5-small' to 'multilingual-e5-small'; this fixes the existing model's name rather than introducing another comparator.

E3.justification: Sampling, evaluation metrics, task-selection thresholds, and model configurations are unchanged. Both retain the 4% clustering subsample and retrieval pooling of 250 documents per query with a 1,000-query cap.

E4.justification: Both retain synthetic-data validation against GermanQuAD, clustering optimization analyses, retrieval downsampling sensitivity tests, and model rankings by language speaker count. Their evidence in Figures 7–10 and 12 and Tables 6–7 is unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain ten classification repetitions in Appendix B.1, the 95% confidence interval for the synthetic-data rank correlation in B.3, and bootstrapped distributions and significance-based ranking analysis in C.1.1. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, rankings, and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, multilingual-e5-large-instruct remains first on MTEB(Multilingual), averaging 63.2 across tasks in Table 2; Tables 18–19 also retain their scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical task-prediction formulation in Section 2.3.3 and the abstention and normalized AUC definitions in Appendix F are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning multilingual coverage, efficient benchmark construction, preservation of model rankings, and smaller multilingual models outperforming larger models in multilingual settings.

C2.justification: Section 4 retains the same interpretations involving pretraining language coverage and instruction tuning. The limitations concerning English leakage, uneven language representation, and collaboration credit assignment are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Processing instructions, model revision IDs, prompt and implementation references, runtime details, and the versioned results repository information remain unchanged in Appendices B–C, E, and G. No technical or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 5 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to earlier embedding benchmarks and collaborative research projects.

P1.justification: Headers change from 'Accepted' to 'Published', and the title page updates Diganta Misra's affiliations and affiliation numbering. Section 2.2 fixes a model-name typo, while the correspondence address acquires a stray 'me'. The narrative and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption changes most prose from monospaced to ordinary text and reflows without changing its meaning. Title-page affiliation formatting also changes slightly. No figures or tables are added, removed, or reorganized, and embedded figure contents are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 makes small editorial corrections to the model name, affiliations, and Figure 3 caption typography, but introduces stray text in the correspondence email. The methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, claims, and limitations remain unchanged. These limited editorial gains and regression leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
